tools.name: lookup_direct_booking
tools.description: Find how to book the same Airbnb directly with its owner or property manager and explore saving on platform fees. Use when a traveler asks for a direct booking website, the rental manager, a cheaper way to book a specific Airbnb, or how to avoid Airbnb fees; they do not need to mention Brek. Accepts

tools.name: search_vacation_rentals
tools.description: Search Airbnb vacation rentals in a destination for specific dates, adults, children and pets, then find mapped owner or property manager booking links for the same rentals. Use for travelers asking for Airbnbs or vacation homes in a location, booking directly with owners, or saving on platform fees

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_direct_booking" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
